name: Chevalier (Marshal Archetype)
body:
Some marshals know that being able to cross the battlefield can grant more heart to your allies than leading from one position.

Mount (Ex)

At 1st level, a chevalier forms a bond with an animal as the druid class feature using their marshal level as their effective druid level. The animal chosen must be able to bear the chevalier as a rider. A chevalier readies two fewer auras per day.

Mounted Inspiration (Ex)

At 2nd level, a chevalier has the ability to grant aid to allies while continuing to maneuver around the battlefield. They gain Mounted Combat as a bonus feat without needing to meet the prerequisites. Additionally, whenever the chevalier uses their inspire action ability, if they are mounted, their mount may move up to one half its move speed. This movement does not count against the mount’s movement in that or the following round.

This ability replaces vital inspiration.

Ride By Motivation (Ex)

At 3rd level, a chevalier’s auras are effective in a wider area thanks to their mobility. The chevalier’s auras affects all allies within 10 feet of any square the chevalier moved through during their turn. This lasts until the start of the chevalier’s next turn. In addition, the chevalier gains Ride By Attack as a bonus feat. If the chevalier already possesses Ride By Attack they instead gain a combat feat of their choice for which they meet the prerequisites.

This ability replaces the Skill Focus bonus feat normally gained at 3rd level.

Mobile Tactician (Ex)

At 4th level, whenever a chevalier uses the tactician ability while mounted, they may use their move action to have their mount move at 1.5 times its normal base move speed (rounded down to the nearest 5 feet).

This ability modifies tactician.

One with the Saddle (Ex)

At 4th level, when a chevalier gains the bonus teamwork feat from tactician, their mount also gains that feat, if the animal is unable to perform actions associated with the teamwork feat they are still considered to possess it for the purpose of any bonuses the chevalier would gain. In addition, at 8th and 16th levels when the chevalier would gain a bonus teamwork feat, they may instead choose to gain a bonus feat which lists Mounted Combat in its prerequisites.

This ability replaces twin aura and modifies the teamwork feats gained at 8th and 16th level.

Twin Aura (Ex)

A chevalier gains this ability at 11th level in place of triple aura.

Triple Aura (Ex)

A chevalier gains this ability at 19th level in place of quadruple aura.
